I am 68 years old. I finished primary school when I was a boy, and that was all. Last year was my first year managing this land myself. My brother farmed here for decades, but he went to live with his son in Handan, so the 10.1 mu came to me. I have my wife and myself, two people total. Last year I watched what my neighbor Lao Wang did on his wheat-maize land and his cotton plot, and I copied him. It worked out, so this year I will do the same.

I divide my land the same as last year: 7 mu for wheat then maize, and 3.1 mu for cotton. 

For the wheat, last October I bought improved wheat seed, 30 jin per mu — that is 15 kg per mu. I rotary tilled the ground and put down one big bag of compound fertilizer per mu, 50 kg of 15-15-15, as my basal dressing. Then in March when the wheat turned green, I topdressed with half a bag of urea per mu, about 25 kg. The input dealer told me that gives me about 16 kg of nitrogen per mu total, and I also get my phosphorus and potassium from the compound. I irrigate three times: once in November for winter irrigation, once at jointing stage in April, and once when the grain is filling in May. I spray pesticide three times — twice for aphids and once for weeds. Last year I harvested 500 kg per mu. Fertilizer costs more this year, but I will not cut back. I would rather waste some fertilizer than lose yield. A bad harvest means no money for my wife's medicine.

For maize, I plant immediately after cutting wheat in early June. Everyone here uses hybrid maize seed now — you cannot get a good crop without it. I plant about 2.5 kg per mu. I do not till, I plant directly into the wheat stubble. At sowing I put down 50 kg of compound fertilizer per mu, same 15-15-15. I irrigate twice: once right after planting if the rain does not come, and once at the big trumpet stage in July. I spray three times: herbicide once right after sowing, and insecticide twice. Last year I got 550 kg per mu. This year I will do exactly the same.

Cotton is on 3.1 mu. I rotary till in April. I sow improved cotton seed, about 3 jin per mu — 1.5 kg per mu. I put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu as basal, and then topdress again when flowering starts. Cotton needs more spraying. Last year I sprayed 5 times for bollworm and other pests, mostly in July and August. I irrigate three times. Last year I picked 250 kg per mu of seed cotton. I will keep the same this year.

I think about my whole budget. I am old, my wife is old, we do not hire much labor. We have our own well for irrigation, so we do that ourselves. If I spend less on fertilizer to save 200 yuan, I might lose 500 yuan in grain. So I keep the same amounts as last year. That is what I know works.
